dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: "While rock stays hard, the mountain shall never fail; while the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail." We are the Millelith — Protectors of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I'm a soldier, proud to be serving with the Millelith in defense of this great city of Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...I say that. But I'd still rather be working closer to Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: That's where my beloved daughter is. I think about her constantly...
